item.title: Hotel.
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Akatsuki Works Black
  • 発売日: 2011-12-22
  • スコア: 7.06/10 (20 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Hotel.
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

Keisuke is the vice manager of the Hotel Primeiro, a warm respite for the hearts of weary travellers. He is an overly serious individual who strictly enforces the hotel’s rules. In the comforts of his room, he listens to a melody over and over again. After he heard a similar music coming from the lobby, he headed there to find a girl playing the guitar. When he asked her for the name of the song she was playing, she rushed at him with a knife. Fortunately, he was able to stop her by grabbing the blade. She collapsed to the ground, not knowing why she just did that.

  • 日本語名: 揺り籠より天使まで
  • 英語名: Yurikago yori Tenshi made

あらすじ

This fully voiced battle ADV is the first title by a revamped Akatsuki Works Black team. Hiro spends his days attending school without a goal in his life. Two years ago, he inherited an unworldly object known as the knight frame, which can cause great destruction at a whim. He is determined not to use these powers because they would be a disturbance to everyone else. Even though he hates himself, he believes that this is the best thing to do.

  • 日本語名: イヅナ斬審剣
  • 英語名: Izuna Zanshinken

あらすじ

Koutarou arrives in Yuunagi City, in order to enter the service of the Kuzuryuu yakuza family. A slender young man with an apparently innocent manner, he reveals the other side of his nature during a rather abrupt test from his new ‘owner’, his cold eyes promising death. He is there to replace his father as Izuna for Yuunagi City, claiming the lives of true villains at the orders of his new master.

item.title: Minzoku Injou
item.description:

  • 日本語名: 民族淫嬢
  • 英語名: Minzoku Injou

あらすじ

Izanagi has a special ability. That is a poison…. He can send a woman into a trance by kissing and making her drink his saliva. Using this ability, he’s got a girlfriend who is from a rich family. One day, a big event called the World Cultural Exchange Expo takes place. His girlfriend’s father tells him to send all girls who take part in it into a trance and offer them to him. It’s a big chance for him to ingratiate himself with him…. Izanagi rapes girls one after another for his secret ambition….
